facts.text: The patrol as Oona's dead is Living Server lore.

story:
Masrim of Fort Atla has heard of more sightings of the Albion undead, and the rogues of Midgard go looking for a patrol of them with a skull Gunnolf of Vindsaul Faste wants to see. They are told to look in Yggdra Forest. The patrol they find stands in Raumarik, by the river fork where the Hibernian Oona raises the dead she kills, among undead soldiers who are not Albion's at all.

The shadows of Loki's house have argued about it in Jordheim's tavern since. Some say the patrol walks between the frontier and the south, and was in Yggdra when Masrim heard of it and in Raumarik by the time anyone got there. Some say Masrim's word was wrong. The Galplen tellers say the patrol is Oona's, the first of the dead she raised, and that she sends it north to be seen so that Midgard will look for its enemies in the wrong forest. The skull goes to Gunnolf either way, and Gunnolf, looking at it, says it is a Midgard skull.
legend: The Undead Patrol is a level 40 undead in Raumarik, not Yggdra as the rogue epic The War Continues says: it stands among undead soldiers (49-52) next to Oona (65), the Hibernian epic boss at the river fork. Pull it very carefully away from the soldiers and especially from Oona. Take the skull to Gunnolf in Vindsaul Faste. No spells on the patrol itself.

aggro: (The dead soldier raises a rusted blade.)
